moiz-za-etsy-seller-seo-system-root.description: Etsy SEO optimization for existing and new listings. Auto-detects REWRITE (current title + tags + description pasted) or CREATE (short product context). Triggers on "rewrite this listing", "optimize my Etsy listing", "fix my title and tags", "create new listing". Uses live Etsy autocomplete + competitor SERP scraping for evidence-driven keyword research.
